The address is not the account.  →  Addresses</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 96,129 96,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,219 181,219 181,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,219 521,219 521,260"/><a href="../crypto/addresses/"><rect class="cm-box" x="20" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="96" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Address</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Every account, of either kind, holds exactly these four.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 266,129 266,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,189 96,189 96,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,189 266,189 266,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,189 436,189 436,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,189 606,189 606,200"/><rect class="cm-box" x="190" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="266" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">The four fields</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>A sequential counter of transactions sent. The field that decides the kind.  →  What the code actually is</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,189 606,189 606,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,238 C606,279 181,279 181,320"/><a href="../contracts/what-the-code-is/"><rect class="cm-box" x="530" y="200" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="606" y="223" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">codeHash</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Controlled by a key that lives off the chain. On-chain exactly as much as any account.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 436,129 436,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,249 181,249 181,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 181,219 181,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 351,219 351,260"/><rect class="cm-box" x="360" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="436" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">EOA</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Controlled by code that lives on the chain, where anyone can read it.  →  What a smart contract is</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 606,129 606,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,249 181,249 181,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,249 351,249 351,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,219 351,219 351,260"/><a href="../contracts/smart-contracts/"><rect class="cm-box" x="530" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="606" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Contract account</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>One field answers it — an empty codeHash means no code, so no contract.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,238 C606,279 181,279 181,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,249 181,249 181,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,249 181,249 181,320"/><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="320" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="343" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Which kind is it?</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>The balance field is the same field for both kinds. Code can own money.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,238 C266,279 351,279 351,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,249 351,249 351,320"/><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="320" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="343" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Contracts hold ether</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>The wallet is software holding keys. Losing it does not touch the account.  →  Wallets and seed phrases</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 181,219 181,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,219 181,219 181,260"/><a href="../wallets/seed-phrases/"><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Not your wallet</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Nothing happens by itself. Every chain of execution begins with a signature.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 351,219 351,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,219 351,219 351,260"/><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Only an EOA starts</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>An entry appears the moment something is put at an address. No act of creation.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,219 521,219 521,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,238 C266,279 521,279 521,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,358 C521,369 351,369 351,380"/><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="320" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="343" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Nothing creates one</text></g><g class="cm-node"><title>The lookup key is the hash of the address, not the address itself.  →  Keccak-256</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,219 521,219 521,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,298 C521,339 351,339 351,380"/><a href="../crypto/keccak256/"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">keccak256(address)</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Hashing the key is what stops anyone picking where in the structure they land.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,298 C521,339 351,339 351,380"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,358 C521,369 351,369 351,380"/><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="380" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="403" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">You cannot choose</text></g></svg></section>
